Detailed Description

Response sequence class for generating default response sequence for Reverse BTA for Generic BFM. This class is extended from svt_mipi_dsi_device_base_sequence class for applying configuration on the generated sequence. It will receive packet from the Device driver and generate Response Trigger and pass it to the Device driver to send response transaction. If internal memory is enable then, packet fields will be updated from the device driver. This class should be registered into the testcases to generate response sequence.
